newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's jobless graduates to go on hunger strike.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's jobless graduates to go on hunger strike.

text.p: More than 800 unemployed Moroccan graduates will stage a 48-hour hunger strike on Tuesday to press demands for jobs, the national association of jobless graduates said on Monday.

"The Moroccan authorities refused to open a dialogue over their urgent demands...Therefore a 48-hour hunger strike will take place on Tuesday. It will be followed by a peaceful demonstration on Friday," the association said in a statement.
The graduates would demonstrate before the parliament building in the city centre and will be joined by colleaques from all over the country, a spokesman said.
More than 800 graduates have gathered in Rabat so far to take part in the demonstration and a sit-in which started last week still continues, the spokesman added.
Officials at the Interior Ministry were not immediatelty available for comment.

Last May, an estimated 2,000 jobless graduates went on a three-week sit-in and hunger strike at the headquarters of the Moroccan Labour Union in protest against what they said was the government's failure to provide them with jobs.
